title: Clone Graph
statement:
Given a reference of a node in a connected undirected graph, you need to clone it.
Return the BFS traversal level-order of the cloned graph starting from node 1. The input graph will be represented by an edge list. Nodes are labeled 1 to n.
In this environment, simply read the edges, build your graph, clone it using a deep copy method (e.g. mapping original nodes to cloned nodes), and then output the BFS order of your *cloned* graph starting at node 1.
inputFormat:
Line 1: n and e.
Next e lines: u and v.
outputFormat: Print the BFS order of the cloned graph from node 1.
